title: Gazebo Read
text: Receive messages from Gazebo server, 2 outputs, {Message type} sets Gazebo message type; {Topic source} sets the source for specifying topic, {Topic}, {Sample time} sets the sampling time of input and {Number of Joint Axis}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: IsNew
ports.summary: Status of messages in the previous time step 0 (default) | 1

params.name: Topic source
params.values: Source for specifying topic From Gazebo (default) | Specify your own

params.name: Message type
params.values: Gazebo message type gazebo_msgs/Pose (default) | gazebo_msgs/Image | gazebo_msgs/IMU | gazebo_msgs/LaserScan | gazebo_msgs/JointState | gazebo_msgs/LinkState

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sampling time of input 0.001 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Number of Joint Axis
params.values: Number of joint axis 2 (default) | positive integer in range [1, 100]
